comment: Independent zap.c witness for zap_map()'s downward striking arm: the debug Tourist wishes a wand of striking, writes Elbereth in the dust with her finger, zaps the wand down, and looks at the floor. zap_updown() reaches zap_map(), whose WAN_STRIKING/SPE_FORCE_BOLT case wipes the engraving through engrave.c wipe_engr_at(d(2,4)).
